Current-book implied capex = buildupCny.annualDepreciation × 13 yr (UK book life) — e.g. mach-vmc3 376,127; mach-lathe-cnc 273,524; mach-vmc5 901,396; mach-dmg-dmu50 806,475; mach-haas-umc500 616,698; mach-drill 191,492; laser-trumpf-3030 1,830,030; robot-mig-cell 805,840 CNY.

Evidence v book: Chinese 3-axis VMC ASP 287,816 (book 376,127, +31%); Chinese slant-bed lathe ≈215,423 (book 273,524, +27%); Chinese 5-axis ASP 2.0–2.4M (book 901,396, −60%); fibre laser book 1.83M looks high against Bodor's 2019 all-power ASP 430k but no 2026 6 kW price was found.
Book finance 4% on half capex v LPR 1-yr 3.0% / 5-yr 3.5% (Sep 2026). Book life 13 yr v China EIT minimum 10 yr (plus full expensing ≤5M CNY in 2024–2027).
Maker ASPs are ex-VAT ex-works and exclude freight, installation and options; delivered-to-plant cost is higher by an unsourced amount.
